lesson.title: what the bread and the cup are doing
lesson.hook: a small square of bread and a tiny cup, passed down the row

title: the last dinner
hook: a tray comes down the row. it started at one dinner.
cast: today: Ghanaian-American congregation in Houston; an elderly usher in white gloves and a teen girl with braids.
